reviewer.agent: Fable subagent requested by the owner
reviewer.mode: read-only, independent of prior review records until own findings formed

scope: Typed data access SDK revision: design handoff, ADR-004, PRD FR-52..55, CONTRACT-067..074, typing spike; checked against Weft, Truss and Ashlar documentation

verdict.buildPlan: Rethink sequencing: raw-table slices blocked on Weft capabilities that did not exist while Truss, which Weft supports, was last

verification: Claims were checked against primary sources before disposition. Weft grammar limits, the required compile 'security' member, unreleased Weft packages and Ashlar's UMF 0.7 binding with read-time recompilation were confirmed. The claim that Databricks BEGIN ATOMIC is not a transaction was refuted by the Databricks ATOMIC compound statement reference, which defines it as all-or-nothing with SIGNAL for errors; the related claim that committed table versions are not returned was confirmed.

findings.issue: DSL surface exceeds Weft 0.2 grammar (only = and >, AND, ascending key order).
findings.resolution: Owner decision: 0.1 surface is Weft tranche A, requested in the Weft requirements (WR-A1..A9); generated types expose it and targets lacking a form refuse at catalog build (CONTRACT-071).

findings.issue: Slice order inverted: raw-table slices first though only Truss has Weft support.
findings.resolution: Slices resequenced: Truss catalog first, then Postgres/Lakebase, then Unity Catalog/Spark; dependencies mapped to WR IDs.

findings.issue: BEGIN ATOMIC misnamed; Unity Catalog receipts unobtainable.
findings.resolution: BEGIN ATOMIC retained (verified); receipts remain a qualification gate in CONTRACT-073 and WR-B6.

findings.issue: Indeterminate resolvable on Postgres; Delta uniqueness only against SDK writers; idempotency key on every target.
findings.resolution: pg_xact_status reconciliation; sole-writer obligation (owner decision); ReplayingActionExecutor capability split.

findings.issue: CONTRACT-070 conflict table refused the plain case; one view across relational and Truss targets.
findings.resolution: Explicit allow table; ColumnSet-bound Fields cannot carry missing, and Truss ABSENT for them refuses.

findings.issue: Stage one and stage two collide in one directory.
findings.resolution: Reserved stage-two paths with their own manifest and CATALOG_STALE check.

findings.issue: Truss login custody for person-required; Truss runtime refuses timestamp/binary projections.
findings.resolution: Owner decision: SDK passes host connections through; Truss decides attribution; raw targets declare sessionPrincipal. Truss value limits recorded under T-1 and open decision 1.

findings.issue: Ashlar binds UMF 0.7 and recompiles at read time.
findings.resolution: A-1 extended with core 0.8 admission and recompilation byte equality.

findings.issue: Missing dependencies: security member, Weft release, raw-table binding profiles, Truss page API arguments.
findings.resolution: WR-I6, WR-I1, U-2 and catalog artifacts that carry Truss page arguments.

findings.issue: Typing gaps: into(), Page key type, include_keys result, if_present with MISSING, mypy return inference.
findings.resolution: Per-Record into overloads, Page[R, K], WithKeys, if_present limited to MISSING; untested forms listed in the spike README.

findings.issue: Temporal Key components and missing facets.
findings.resolution: Temporal Key components refuse; integer and decimal facets required for ColumnSets.

findings.issue: Search pre-filter, hydration, RRF depth and timing.
findings.resolution: Result-defined filtering with explicit partial opt-in, single-key hydration, rrf(k, depth), stated timing.

findings.issue: Proportion of browser parity; pin the runtime ABI.
findings.resolution: runtimeAbi in the manifest; B-TP-001 tests generated output against the pinned runtime. Browser parity kept under ADR-002.

limitations: Design evidence only; no implementation or native qualification.
